target.title: feat: add poll unvote and option updates
target.body:
## Summary
- add bridge actions for native poll unvote and add-option updates
- expose `imsg poll unvote` and `imsg poll add-option`
- expose JSON-RPC `polls.unvote` / `polls.addOption` plus existing-style aliases
- add status selector reporting, docs, changelog, and command/RPC coverage

## Redacted proof
Proof collected on lobster with branch-local artifacts from `feat/poll-unvote-add-option` and a freshly relaunched injected Messages.app session. Raw logs are kept local because they include chat GUIDs, message GUIDs, handles, and participant identifiers. A local screenshot confirmed Messages recognized the payload as a Poll extension (`sent a poll` plus `Add Choice`), but it did not show the options rendered as a normal poll UI; the option proof below comes from command responses and history decode, not from the screenshot.

- `main` head: `c541bea2828f773e85588d0598ed3565140736f2`
- branch head: `0213ff2640b3ffc6fce94882fac23b4a30b05585`
- before on `main`: `make build` passed; `imsg poll` help listed only `send|vote`; completions search for `poll unvote`, `poll add-option`, `polls.unvote`, and `polls.addOption` returned no matches
- after on branch: `make build` passed; `imsg launch --dylib "$PWD/bin/imsg-bridge-helper.dylib"` succeeded; `imsg status --json` reported `v2_ready=true`, `advanced_features=true`, and selectors `pollPayloadMessage=true`, `pollVoteMessage=true`, `pollUpdateMessage=true`
- after command/RPC surface: completions include `imsg poll unvote` and `imsg poll add-option`; status reports `poll.unvote`, `polls.unvote`, `messages.poll.unvote`, `poll.addOption`, `polls.addOption`, and `messages.poll.addOption`
- live proof in the redacted test group: sent a poll with options `[Alpha, Beta]`, voted `Alpha` with `removed=false`, unvoted `Alpha` with `removed=true`, then added option `Gamma`
- history readback: created poll decoded with the proof question and `[Alpha, Beta]`; unvote update decoded as `kind=vote`, `event=imessage.poll.voted`, `option_text=Alpha`, `event_type=removed`; add-option update decoded with `original_guid` back to the poll and option `[Gamma]`

## Verification
- `make build` ✅
- GitHub CI ✅ (`macos`, `linux-read-core`, Socket checks all pass)
- `make test` ⚠️ blocked before project tests run on this host: `Tests/IMsgCoreTests/BridgeHelperLocatorTests.swift:2:8: error: no such module 'Testing'`
- `make lint` ⚠️ blocked locally on lobster by SwiftLint/SourceKit: `Loading sourcekitdInProc.framework/Versions/A/sourcekitdInProc failed`
